variant_name: Tells analytics which kind of form a message came from: service, location, short or contact. Keep the value the form already has.
card: Puts the form on a light gray background that fills its cell. On for every form except the contact page's.
anchor_id: The name buttons use to jump to the form (#quote). Keep "quote". Use another name only if a page has two forms.
show_needs: Not on any of the site's forms and has no wording yet. Leave off.
show_location: Not on any of the site's forms and has no wording yet. Leave off.
optional_text: An optional word after the **Phone** and **Company** labels, for example "(optional)". Empty on every form.
body_label: Leave empty to drop the project description box, as on the short landing page forms.
photos_note: Optional. A note with a file icon above the button, for example asking visitors to email photos.
submit_label: On the short landing pages it comes from the page's **Form button label** field: change it there.
